All requirements traced to interview statements and confirmed by end-user feedback. Critical design decision pending: internal conversion strategy versus Series-specific schema for metadata preservation.

Cost-performance trade-offs center on compression algorithm selection; availability strategy emphasizes error clarity and retry procedures.
